frequency_question: How often do announced or initiated transfers of complex missile production lines successfully achieve operational status and public reporting within a 3-to-4-year window?
membership_rule: Members are major licensed production or domestic assembly transfer programs for complex cruise/precision strike munitions to allied/partner nations. Excluded are simple ammunition, unguided munitions, or purely research-stage concepts.

cases.name: South Korea Taurus KEPD 350 domestic integration attempt
Turkey SOM missile domestic production program
Taiwan Hsiung Feng IIE domestic production
Pakistan Babur cruise missile series production

coverage_note: 6 named; believed roughly 8-9 major comparable programs in total globally.
known_gaps: Classified domestic programs in smaller nations lacking open-source verification are omitted.
skeleton: Total verified missile technology transfer and domestic manufacturing attempts vs those successfully operationalized within the timeframe.
validity_reason: Defense industrial base transfer dynamics and verification standards evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
